claims.text: Perioperative chemo (before and after surgery), typically FLOT (5-fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin, docetaxel)
claims.quote: Patients often receive perioperative chemotherapy (ie, before surgery and after surgery) typically with the FLOT regimen (5-fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin, docetaxel) (2).

claims.text: Advanced HER2+ dz: trastuzumab (targets HER2) or ramucirumab (VEGF inhibitor) w chemo may be used
claims.quote: For advanced disease with tumors that express human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2+), trastuzumab (a monoclonal antibody that targets HER2) or ramucirumab (a vascular endothelial growth factor [VEGF] inhibitor) in conjunction with chemotherapy may be used.

claims.text: PD-L1+ advanced or metastatic gastric CA: immunotherapy such as pembrolizumab
claims.quote: Immunotherapy such as with pembrolizumab is available for use in patients with programmed cell death ligand 1 (PD-L1)–positive advanced or metastatic gastric cancer.
